component.name: AudioDub AI
component.summary: Native desktop audio translation and voice dubbing

description.p: AudioDub AI is a native Linux desktop application built with GTK4 and Libadwaita that converts spoken audio from one language into natural spoken audio in another language.
Features include automatic language detection, speaker diarization, natural timestamp-aligned speech generation, and local deterministic audio assembly using FFmpeg.
Initial release of AudioDub AI for Fedora Linux.
